title: ?boss=1 opens a run on THE BOSS (the door counted as the sector before) for the morning's playtest; Isao's decoding joke is held 7 s before the ending begins
context: After 2026-10-15-boss-sector-first-version and 2026-10-16-descent-mission-first-version: a late start (?skip=defence&sector=N at or past the door's earliest) makes N the door, so THE BOSS could only be reached by playing the door through (the browser step does, with culls, in three minutes); the owner wanted something to play in the morning. And the descent's joke was a brief said the instant the cave closed, with the finale starting over it.
outcome: src/platform/game-flags.js reads ?boss; src/platform/story-world.js carries story.bossStart; src/fx/sector-run.js: with it, a first sector past the door's earliest counts the door as the sector before, so the run opens on THE BOSS (index.html?skip=defence&sector=8&boss=1#td); without it the late start is the door as before (test/sector-run.mjs both ways; browser --boss-start). DESCENT.jokeHold 7: src/fx/descent-host.js lets the joke stand that long after the cave closes before the ending's `then` runs.
alternatives: Change every late start past the door to open on the boss: rejected; the door's own entry (sector 7 or 8) is a playtest entry too.
evidence: node test/sector-run.mjs, test/descent.mjs; npm test (263), npm run check, npm run build; browser --boss-start, --descent, --sectors green
